name: ts-review-clean-tests
description: Clean PR (false-positive check). Tests only, and they pass. Nothing Important to report.
setup: cd "$EVAL_ROOT" && git apply "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/review/ts-clean-tests.patch" && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'test: mixed currencies on subtract, zero sum'
prompt: Review the last commit (git show HEAD) following REVIEW.md and print the findings table. Then end with exactly one line: IMPORTANT_FINDINGS: <number of Important findings>. Do not modify files.

checks.why: a clean change gets no Important finding
